long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Magnitogorsk, Viktor Rashnikov entered the city's steel works as a repair-shop mechanic. He studied metal-forming engineering while working and advanced through production, supply and technical posts before becoming chief executive. Over that career he accumulated shares through market purchases, eventually taking control of MMK and later moving from day-to-day management to the chairmanship.

Rashnikov's later public role stayed closely tied to Magnitogorsk. He became president of Metallurg Magnitogorsk, the city's ice-hockey club, and maintained the association alongside his leadership at MMK. The sporting commitment provides a durable second strand to a career formed almost entirely within the same industrial city and company.
